# KeepFlip

> KeepFlip helps solo flippers who source in person and sell on eBay research a find, count costs before buying, and track inventory and profit through the sale.

## Product

- KeepFlip has an Android app and a browser workspace.
- Free accounts can use the KeepFlip workspace on Android and web, with up to 10 inventory items, 10 active listings, and 20 AI valuations per month. Free account setup starts in the Android app and does not require a credit card.
- Scan and resale values are estimates. Resellers review the evidence and make their own buy decisions.
- KeepFlip connects to eBay through eBay sign-in and authorized eBay APIs for selected seller and listing details.
- KeepFlip is not a five-marketplace crosslisting tool.

## Pricing

- The US web Serious Reseller plan is $18 per month or $180 per year. Annual billing saves $36 compared with 12 monthly payments.
- One paid plan includes every KeepFlip feature and up to 250 active listings total.
- The web checkout does not currently include a free trial.
- Google Play shows its purchase price in the store before confirmation. The public listing currently reports in-app purchases from $18 to $180.
